primary.title: Gold and silver investments: Should you buy physical gold, ETFs or mutual funds? Liquidity, costs and risks compared
primary.summary: Investors can choose from physical gold and silver, digital gold, ETFs, mutual funds, Sovereign Gold Bonds and Electronic Gold Receipts. Each option differs in costs, liquidity, regulation, taxation and storage needs, making it important to compare the risks before investing.
